# costgraph_virtual_tag (Data Source)

Look up one virtual tag by exact key in an authorized tenant. Requires virtual-tags:read. Returns the complete ordered configuration without changing CostGraph. Missing keys return an error. Time-windowed rules cannot be represented by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tenant_id" {
  type = string
}

data "costgraph_virtual_tag" "team" {
  tenant_id = var.tenant_id
  key       = "team"
}

output "ordered_rules" {
  value = data.costgraph_virtual_tag.team.rules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Exact virtual tag key.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID authorized by the API key.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Key description.
- `id` (String) Virtual tag key UUID.
- `revision` (String) Aggregate metadata and rules revision.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered rules, including stable references and server UUIDs. The first active matching rule wins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `rules_revision` (Number) Server rules revision.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the rule participates in matching.
- `expression` (String) CostQL matching condition.
- `id` (String) Server rule UUID.
- `inherited_from` (String) Inherited CostQL value expression, or null for literal rules.
- `rule_key` (String) Stable reference within this key. Legacy rules expose their existing UUID.
- `scope` (String) CostQL scope, billing or k8s.
- `value` (String) Literal value, or null for inherited rules.
